name: LabelCollection - Deliberate Same Site Members
description: The counter-case to Phantom Members, and the reason the append guard is keyed per-tab on an exact urlKey rather than per-host: the CodeYam group legitimately holds two App Store Connect pages the user filed on purpose, and both survive. The rows are indistinguishable in appearance from phantom ones -- same host, same colliding title, same disambiguating URL subtitles -- so no title-based or host-based collapse could tell them apart without deleting real members. The open tab sits on the /apps slot and is stamped to that same slot, which is a confirmed membership rather than a navigated-away one, so nothing is suppressed.
